name: contactsq
tagline: Governed contacts for people and agents.
description: A governed address book for you and your org. Contact details are encrypted at rest, agents see masked cards and safe greetings rather than raw numbers, callers resolve to a name, and a suppression list stops you contacting people who said no.
shortDescription: Governed contacts with caller-ID and a suppression list; agents never receive raw identifiers
author: QUOX
_pricingNote: Pricing is an open owner decision; price 0 / core-free is a placeholder for P0.
marketingPoints: Governed store: every detail encrypted at rest under a per-contact key
Caller-ID: resolve a number or email to a contact, with a safe greeting for voice agents
Suppression list: do-not-contact entries checked on every resolve
Leased, not given: agents get masked cards, only humans can read raw values

governedStore.name: Governed store
governedStore.description: Per-contact encryption, org isolation, and witnessed reads.

callerId.name: Caller-ID
callerId.description: Resolve a phone number or email to a contact and a safe greeting.

suppression.name: Suppression list
suppression.description: Do-not-call, do-not-market and bounced entries, stored as blind indexes only.

leasedNotGiven.name: Leased, not given
leasedNotGiven.description: Agents receive masked cards; raw identifiers are human-only.

safety._approvalNote: Agents need a person to approve contacts_dial, contacts_send and contacts_context unless a standing grant covers the contact, channel and purpose. Erase, merge and the retention run are human org admin only.

changes: P0 substrate: governed contact store, caller-ID resolve, suppression list, settings, CLI
